info.name: Source
info.summary: Editor for code and configuration files
info.description:
Edit code and configuration files in the browser with the editing model you know from VS Code: syntax highlighting, multiple cursors, regex search and replace, command palette.
Files are saved through WebDAV, so versions, activity and sharing keep working as usual. A file changed by someone else in the meantime is never overwritten silently: both versions are shown side by side.
info.author: Daniel Altiparmak
